scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:bdd && npm run test:compiled
scripts.typecheck:maintenance: tsc --noEmit --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --types node --skipLibCheck scripts/check-package-contents.ts scripts/check-platform-neutral.ts && tsc --noEmit --allowJs --checkJs --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --types node --skipLibCheck bin/howdone.cjs test/bdd/cucumber.cjs test/package/bdd/cucumber.cjs scripts/build-test-artifacts.mjs scripts/run-compiled-tests.mjs scripts/run-cucumber.mjs scripts/sync-package-artifacts.mjs scripts/update-version-badge.mjs
scripts.typecheck:release: tsc --noEmit --allowJs --checkJs --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --types node --skipLibCheck scripts/validate-release.mjs
scripts.verify:precommit: npm run test:all && npm run typecheck:maintenance && npm run check:platform && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=moderate && npm audit --audit-level=moderate && npm run pack:check && git diff --check && git diff --cached --check
